about.title: About Ghusn
about.description: Ghusn is a gift shop in Khartoum: flowers, perfumes, watches, beauty, teddy bears and shilas, wrapped with care to arrive just as you imagined.
about.story: Ghusn is a gift shop in Khartoum that started with a simple idea: a gift should arrive just as the giver imagined it. We choose every piece with care, wrap it by hand, and add the words you want to say.
about.step1: From the online store or the shop: flowers, perfumes, watches, teddy bears, shilas and more.
about.step2: Pick a wrapping style, write your gift card in your own words, and we prepare it with care.
about.step3: Collect it from the shop, or we deliver within Khartoum, Bahri and Omdurman.
about.heroLine: We choose every piece as if it were ours, wrap it by hand, and add the words that are hard to say.
about.storyLead: A gift isn't something you buy; it's a moment someone keeps.
about.storyQuote: We add the words you want to say, and wrap it as if it were ours.
about.journeyTitle: From your choice to their hands
about.value1: Flowers, perfumes, watches and more, piece by piece.
about.value2: Wrapping styles and a gift card in your own words.
about.value3: Khartoum, Bahri and Omdurman, or collect it from the shop.
about.closeText: Browse the categories, or design your gift with its wrapping and card; we take care of the rest.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Ghusn collects, uses and protects your data.
privacy.intro: At Ghusn we respect your privacy. This page explains what data we collect when you buy from our online store or our shop, and how we use and protect it.
privacy.collect1: Order details: your name, phone number (WhatsApp), and delivery address and city.
privacy.collect2: If the gift is for someone else: the recipient's name and phone number, your gift card message and your order notes.
privacy.collect3: Bankak transfers: the transfer receipt image and its reference number, stored privately and never shown publicly. We never see or store your bank account details.
privacy.collect4: Service notes: our team may note your preferences, such as "loves white roses", to serve you better next time.
privacy.use: To prepare and deliver your order, contact you about it on WhatsApp or by phone, verify payment, and keep our sales accounting records. We don't send you marketing unless you ask for it.
privacy.share1: The delivery company: only your name, phone number and address, to deliver the order.
privacy.share2: Technical service providers that host the website and store images (our hosting server and Cloudflare), bound by data protection commitments.
privacy.share3: We never sell or rent your data to anyone.
privacy.browser: Your cart is stored in your browser only. We count visits with a tool that uses no cookies and doesn't identify you (Umami), hosted on our own server.
privacy.keep: We keep order and sales records for as long as accounting records require, and transfer receipts for as long as needed to review the order and payment.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see your data, correct it, or delete anything we don't need for accounting, by messaging us on WhatsApp. We reply within 7 days.
privacy.security: Connections to our site are encrypted (HTTPS), our database isn't open to the internet, backups are encrypted, and only the shop team can see your order.
privacy.changes: We may update this policy; the date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.
privacy.contact: For any question about your privacy: <link>message us on WhatsApp</link>.
privacy.contactNoWa: For any question about your privacy, contact us at the shop or on the phone number on the About page.
